claims: Duke University is a private research university.
Duke University is located in Durham, North Carolina.
Duke University's campus is part of North Carolina's Research Triangle region.
North Carolina's Research Triangle region includes Chapel Hill and Raleigh.
Duke University has a location in Singapore.
Duke-NUS Graduate Medical School is a Duke University location in Singapore.
Duke University has a location in China.
Duke Kunshan University is a Duke University location in China.
